title: Preserve the fork's behavior through integrations and engine replacement

costar.context: The owner requires zero regression as the minimum fork acceptance bar.
costar.objective: Fix observed check failures and require demonstrated behavior parity before replacing existing capabilities.
costar.response: Regression contract, repaired tests and complete available verification results.

concerns: Passing mocked UI checks cannot establish mail engine parity, live provider consent or upgrade safety.
The checked-in baseline contains known incomplete capabilities; freezing its hash does not establish parity with the original upstream fork point.
The registry recorder omitted If-Match even though the client sends it; repair observation without weakening assertions.
A full browser run reported a mail reader stuck loading; reproduce and diagnose before modifying behavior or test timing.
Docker is not currently available in this shell; live-stack verification may remain blocked.
context: Zero regression applies to existing capabilities throughout the fork and independent rewrite. Incremental replacement must retain the current working implementation until equivalence is demonstrated.
current_state: Baseline 533ca73524f0fa0ec82b98ced1a8e4cf03318c14 has 259 passing and two failing unit tests caused by missing recorder headers, formatting failures in new integration tests, and one failed mocked browser mail-reader check. Live OAuth and complete protocol parity remain unverified.
target_design: A documented capability and compatibility floor referenced by agent instructions, with all available CI checks green and remaining live coverage gaps explicitly blocking replacement claims.
changes: Document the zero-regression contract and evidence requirements in REGRESSION.md and reference it from AGENTS.md.
Amend the independent-engine plan so existing capabilities are mandatory replacement scope even when implementation is staged.
Capture request headers faithfully in the registry test recorder, preserving all existing assertions.

Format integration tests and the provider registry. Isolate the existing mail-reader browser fixture from unmocked background admin requests with the same API fallback used by other mocked tests; preserve its rendering and unsafe-content assertions.
boundaries: No engine replacement, removed capability, release tag, deployment, publication or licensing change.
Do not skip tests or weaken functional assertions to make the gate green.
Preserve existing unrelated changes and use only synthetic data.

verification.name: web-gate
verification.command: Run .github/workflows/check.yml web checks locally, including the full unit suite, typecheck, static build and full mocked browser suite.
verification.proves: The complete available web checks pass together, including existing mail and admin behavior.
verification.expected: All checks pass with no exclusions; record any environment limitation.
verification.result: 2026-11-17: full unit suite 261/261 passed across 39 files; full mocked browser suite 12/12 passed in 17.5s; lint checked 326 files with no errors; svelte-check 0 errors and 0 warnings; complete Vite static build succeeded. Registry contracts current; inventory accounts for 57 original files and 13 work packages (planning coverage only); MCPL conformance 28 components, 75 events, 14 lessons, 5 kernels; brand generation check and 5 brand tests passed; all 27 API routes documented. update.sh, auto-update.sh and backup.sh fake-Docker suites all passed under Git Bash. No tests skipped or assertions weakened. Vite commands required escalation after sandbox directory access denial. No runtime code changed; Rust build not rerun.

verification.name: operating-tree
verification.proves: Operating records validate and the full tracked diff has no whitespace errors.
verification.expected: Both pass; identify unrelated baseline errors explicitly.
verification.result: 2026-11-17: git diff --check passed. All three changed plan records validate individually against plan.schema.json with Ajv. Whole operating-tree validator still exits 1 on pre-existing records: .ai/modules/chats/data/sessions/a06e2efe-3026-4fda-a6ec-f81c0faeec17/tools.jsonl line 20 is an unterminated JSON string (confirmed also malformed in HEAD), and 2026-11-01-suite-readiness.json is missing concerns. These historical records were not altered.

verification.name: live-capability-floor
verification.command: Check local Docker availability and the documented disposable stack before running live suites.
verification.proves: Separates actual runtime verification from mocked checks.
verification.expected: Run live checks where available; otherwise explicitly leave protocol, migration and real OAuth parity unverified.
